name: BirdVox-full-night: Bird Flight Call Audio Detection Benchmark
description: BirdVox-full-night contains 6 full-night audio recordings (approximately 62 continuous hours) of nocturnal avian flight calls captured by autonomous bioacoustic monitoring sensors across 6 recording stations in upstate New York during the autumn 2015 bird migration season, annotated with avian flight call timestamps.

publisher.name: New York University / Cornell Lab of Ornithology

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.notes: Dataset released on Zenodo (record 1205569) under CC-BY-4.0.

source_references.title: BirdVox-full-night: a dataset and benchmark for avian flight call detection

verification.notes: Verified against ICASSP 2018 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICASSP.2018.8461410) and Zenodo record (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.1205569).

size.notes: Six continuous FLAC audio recordings with CSV and JAMS avian flight call annotations.

citation.paper_title: BirdVox-full-night: A Dataset and Benchmark for Avian Flight Call Detection
